requirement.name: lab
requirement.note: one operator owns the server and every gateway (in-house IDS lab): no DP needed, best detection

requirement.name: cloud-aggregator
requirement.note: gateways of one company, aggregation in a third-party cloud: server not trusted, epsilon <= 5

B3: the server sees the client updates in the clear
MGp-nodp: the server sees the client updates in the clear
no DP

requirement.name: hidden-tables
requirement.note: as cloud-aggregator, but the synthetic data stay inside the company: the cloud must not see any gateway's tables, no DP required (round Q1)

B3: the server sees the client updates in the clear
MGp-nodp: the server sees the client updates in the clear

requirement.name: consortium
requirement.note: brokers of different companies that may collude with the aggregator: epsilon must hold with one honest client

B3: the server sees the client updates in the clear
MGp-nodp: the server sees the client updates in the clear
no DP

B3: the server sees the client updates in the clear
MGp-nodp: the server sees the client updates in the clear

requirement.name: low-bandwidth
requirement.note: gateways on NB-IoT / LoRa / metered 4G backhaul

B3: the server sees the client updates in the clear
MGp-nodp: the server sees the client updates in the clear
no DP

requirement.name: rare-attacks
requirement.note: the rare MQTT attacks (DELAYED, SYN, INVALID, WILL) matter most

B3: the server sees the client updates in the clear
MGp-nodp: the server sees the client updates in the clear
no DP

requirement.name: honest-majority
requirement.note: brokers of 5 operators, at most 2 may collude with the aggregator; the released model must resist the membership attack (AUC < 0.55)

B3: the server sees the client updates in the clear
MGp-nodp: the server sees the client updates in the clear
no DP

requirement.name: gateway-dropout
requirement.note: as cloud-aggregator, but up to 2 of the 5 gateways may drop out of a round or leak their noise share: epsilon <= 5 must hold with 3 clients adding their share

B3: the server sees the client updates in the clear
MGp-nodp: the server sees the client updates in the clear
no DP
